notes: Today, we are breaking down Axon Enterprise. You may know Axon as the pioneer of the taser. The business has truly evolved over the years and now has expanded into body cams and other supporting tools for law enforcement and the defense industries. Our guest is Danielle Menichella, portfolio manager at Sands Capital Management. Danielle details not just how Axon expanded its product offering but also how it's shifted its business model from pure hardware to a mix of hardware and software. It's very interesting what unique customer dynamics are driving the growth in certain industries, and we get into a lot of that and more on this episode. So please enjoy this Breakdown on Axon.  Introduction 
 Matt 
Welcome back to Business Breakdowns. This is Matt Reustle. And today, we are breaking down Axon Enterprise. Now you may know Axon as the pioneer of the TASER, but the business has truly evolved over the years and now has expanded into body cams and other supporting tools for law enforcement and the defense industries. Our guest is Danielle Menichella, Portfolio Manager at Sands Capital.

 Danielle details not just how Axon expanded its product offering, but how it shifted that business model from pure hardware to a mix of hardware, software. Given the customer base, I think this is a really interesting episode to pair with Motorola, which we recorded and released about one month ago. It's very interesting when you get into unique customer dynamics, what's driving the growth in certain industries, and we get into a lot of that and more on this episode, so please enjoy the episode on Axon.
